about: LBA1's town pieces drawn as models on the globe's stub islands (Source/.../Import/LBAPlanetKit.h). example: one of the piece's layouts, scene:layout (0-based), as Tools/lba1_kit_survey.py labels pieces_big.png. lba2: ISLAND:body, an island's decor (Tools/lba2_decor_sheet.py draws them). remake: a model under the remake's www/models/lba2 (lba1/... for its LBA1 models). primitive: generated, sized to the piece and colored from its bricks (fence, railing, sack, buoy). yaw (degrees), scale, fit: height (scaled to the piece's height), every: one copy per that many cells along the piece, turn: random. The remake's own LBA1 replacements (barrel, box) are added without a line here.
